'''Freighter PBY-1457''' was an undercover [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used by [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] agent [[Belindi Kalenda]] during her mission to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], it was ambushed upon coming out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and eventually crashed in the sea.
